routes.description: One current page of the declared Redis list with exact zero-based indexes and original values. Use nextInput to continue; live changes can move list indexes.

parameterDescriptions.offset: Zero-based list index within the declared bounds. Continue using the previous result's nextInput.

routes.description: One complete native SSCAN batch from the declared set. A priced page may be empty while iteration continues. Member ordering is unspecified and repeated members are possible across pages.

parameterDescriptions.cursor: Exact native unsigned 64-bit cursor as decimal text. Start at 0, keep all returned rows, then use nextInput until scanComplete is true.
